name: mymind
description: Search, read, and organize your mymind objects, spaces, and tags.

MYMIND_KEY_ID.title: mymind key id (kid)
MYMIND_KEY_ID.description: Access key identifier from https://access.mymind.com/extensions. Used as the JWT kid. The plugin never stores the value.

MYMIND_KEY_SECRET.title: mymind key secret
MYMIND_KEY_SECRET.description: Base64-encoded access key secret from https://access.mymind.com/extensions. Shown only once at creation. The plugin never stores the value.

MYMIND_USER_AGENT.title: User-Agent
MYMIND_USER_AGENT.description: Optional. User-Agent sent on every request. The API requires one; if unset, the plugin uses mymind-agent-plugin/0.1.0.
